The root product is not consumable through a stable semantic-version tag while its manifest retains local path dependencies. The public 0.1.0 tag is withdrawn; branch consumption is the current supported route for SumDay.

NativeAgentSumday cannot currently be resolved from the public Git repository, whether pinned by tag or branch. SumDay must retain the local copy until a remote-resolvable root manifest is reviewed and resolved.
observedRecovery: The first fresh macOS build stopped on ENOSPC while task-owned scratch directories filled the disk. Those task scratch directories were removed and a clean macOS 15 build passed.
